name: News, Newspapers
description: Today's newspaper front pages from the Freedom Forum archive, one paper per render, filling the cell's width from the top. Rotates through the papers listed on its admin page (Widgets → News, Newspapers), each with its own optional CSS, or shows one pinned paper. The rotation moves on at most once every four minutes, so a send prepared ahead of time and its follow-ups show one paper; that approximates one paper per shown frame, and two sends within four minutes repeat a paper. Pages download in the background as PDFs, drawn 1440 px wide so body text stays readable (Freedom Forum's 700 px JPEG stands in when a PDF can't be had), and the last good page stays up while a paper isn't out yet. No API key needed.
